svg.title: The trie after inserting cat, car, card, care, dog
svg.desc: root (pass 5, end 0) has children c and d. c (pass 4, end 0) leads by a to ca (pass 4, end 0). ca leads by r to car (pass 3, end 1) and by t to cat (pass 1, end 1). car leads by d to card (pass 1, end 1) and by e to care (pass 1, end 1). d (pass 1, end 0) leads by o to do (pass 1, end 0), which leads by g to dog (pass 1, end 1). Nodes where a word ends are green.
